name: Extreme Demand Avoidance – 8 (EDA-8)
directions: Caregiver report of the child’s behaviour during the last six months. No diagnostic cutoff is applied.
timeframe: Caregiver report of the child’s behaviour during the last six months. No diagnostic cutoff is applied.

questions.text: Obsessively resists and avoids ordinary demands and requests
Is driven by the need to be in charge
Tells other children how they should behave, but does not feel these rules apply to themselves
Has difficulty complying with demands unless they are carefully presented
Seems unaware of the differences between themselves and authority figures (e.g., parents, teachers, police)
Mood changes very rapidly (e.g., switches from affectionate to angry in an instant)
Uses outrageous or shocking behaviour to get out of doing something
Has bouts of extreme emotional responses to small events (e.g., crying/giggling, becoming furious)

interpretationNote: This form and scoring profile were entered from user-supplied material. Results are screening or descriptive information only and do not establish a diagnosis.
